_help: The Real Toys page: ideas for physical toys, to see which ones people want. Each concept: id (short, no spaces), name, line, cover (a picture in assets/covers), points (what it is), and price (a rough guess or 'TBD'). Visitors tap 'I want this' and can leave their email in the form at the bottom. Votes go to your analytics tool; emails go to your email tool with the chosen toys in an 'interest' field.
label: Real Toys

text: We are thinking about making real, physical toys. Tap the ones you would want, and we will build the most wanted first.
